label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 083 ]

blocks.text: Some people carry on active social lives with computers - their own or the ones available at terminals in public places like cafes, social centers, libraries, etc. Communicating with others on "bulletin boards", they get to know people they might never meet in traditional way. For example, a graduate student in San Francisco, California, has made more than fifty "net friends", including a homeless vegetarian who gets around on roller-blades, an HIV-positive police officer, some members of an Iranian family, an 80-year-old detective, and a medical geneticist who studies DNA. She has gone out on dates with about ten of her "network contacts". In fact, she almost married one. The romance didn't last. However, She doesn't blame the computer for breaking up the relationship.

readingSentences.english: Honesty in friendship is valued above almost all other virtues.
readingSentences.korean: 우정에 있어서 정직함은 거의 모든 다른 덕목보다 높이 평가받는다.

readingSentences.english: A true friend will tell you the truth even when it is uncomfortable to hear.
readingSentences.korean: 진정한 친구는 듣기에 불편할 때조차도 당신에게 진실을 말해줄 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Flattery may feel pleasing at first, but it lacks genuine substance.
readingSentences.korean: 아첨은 처음에는 듣기 좋을지 모르지만 진정한 실체가 결여되어 있다.

readingSentences.english: Mutual respect and sincere counsel form the bond of lasting companionship.
readingSentences.korean: 상호 존중과 진심 어린 조언이 지속되는 동반자적 유대감을 형성한다.
